table.name: city
table.purpose: World cities with their country, district and population (MySQL world sample database).

CountryCode.name: Country code
CountryCode.description: ISO 3-letter country code identifying the country the city belongs to; references country.Code.

District.name: District
District.description: State, province or region within the country that the city is located in (e.g. California, Punjab, Nagano).

ID.name: City ID
ID.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the city. Referenced by country.Capital to point at a country's capital city.

Name.name: City name
Name.description: Name of the city (e.g. Matsumoto, Lubao).

Population.name: City population
Population.description: Number of inhabitants of the city; ranges from 42 to 10,500,000.

table.name: country
table.purpose: Reference table of world countries with demographic, geographic and political attributes.

Capital.name: Capital city ID
Capital.description: ID of the country's capital city; references city.ID. Null for territories without a capital.

Code.name: Country code (ISO 3-letter)
Code.description: Primary key; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. ABW, USA).

Code2.name: Country code (ISO 2-letter)
Code2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. AD, US).

Continent.name: Continent
Continent.description: Continent the country lies in: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, (Antarctica).

GNP.name: Gross National Product
GNP.description: Country's GNP, presumably in millions of US dollars (values like 82710 for large economies, 0 for tiny territories).

GNPOld.name: Old GNP
GNPOld.description: Gross National Product from an earlier reference year, same unit as GNP; null for ~25% of countries.

GovernmentForm.name: Government form
GovernmentForm.description: Type of government, e.g. Republic, Constitutional Monarchy, Dependent Territory of the UK.

HeadOfState.name: Head of state
HeadOfState.description: Name of the country's head of state (data circa 2000s: George W. Bush, Jacques Chirac, Elisabeth II).

IndepYear.name: Independence year
IndepYear.description: Year the country became independent; negative values for BCE dates (e.g. -1523). Null for dependent territories.

LifeExpectancy.name: Life expectancy
LifeExpectancy.description: Average life expectancy at birth in years (37.2–83.5).

LocalName.name: Local name
LocalName.description: Country's name in its local language(s) (e.g. 'Lao', 'Al-Jaza’ir/Algérie').

Population.name: Country population
Population.description: Number of inhabitants of the country; 0 for uninhabited territories, up to ~1.28 billion.

Region.name: Region
Region.description: Geographic sub-region within the continent (e.g. Caribbean, Western Africa, Southeast Asia).

SurfaceArea.name: Surface area
SurfaceArea.description: Country's area in square kilometers (0.4 to 17,075,400).

table.name: countrylanguage
table.purpose: Languages spoken in each country, with share of population and official status.

CountryCode.name: Country code
CountryCode.description: ISO 3-letter country code; references country.Code. Together with Language forms the row identity.

IsOfficial.name: Is official language
IsOfficial.description: Whether the language is an official language of the country ('T' = true, 'F' = false).

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Name of a language spoken in the country (e.g. English, Urdu, Oromo).

Percentage.name: Percentage of speakers
Percentage.description: Share of the country's population speaking the language, in percent (0–100).
